## GEO Inside
GEO Inside는 주요 AI 답변에서 브랜드가 어떻게 언급되고 어떤 출처가 인용되는지 살펴보는 플랫폼입니다. 국내 검색·질문 자료를 바탕으로 질문 후보를 만들고 담당자가 대표 측정 질문을 확정합니다. ChatGPT·Gemini·Perplexity 답변을 반복 측정하고 네이버 AI탭은 별도 기준으로 관측합니다. 답변 원문·인용 URL·경쟁 브랜드 비교를 바탕으로 개선할 콘텐츠와 실행 과제를 제안합니다.

GEO Inside observes brand mentions and cited sources in major AI answers. It develops question candidates from Korean search and question material, with a responsible person finalizing the representative measurement set. It repeatedly measures ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity answers and observes Naver's AI tab separately. Full answers, citation URLs, and competitor comparisons inform content and execution tasks.

Question candidates may draw on the customer's website, products, target keywords and customer language together with relevant Naver Knowledge iN, cafe and blog material, DataLab search trends, news, and YouTube content when available. AI proposes drafts for discovery, comparison, and recommendation stages; a responsible person reviews the evidence and finalizes the set. Not every source is used for every question.

One example measurement configuration repeats one question seven times per engine per day across three global engines for 28 days: 196 observations per engine and 588 across the three engines. Actual repetition, cadence, review, and reporting scope are agreed for each engagement. Wilson 95% confidence intervals estimate a range for a measured proportion under defined assumptions; they do not mean 95% answer accuracy or guarantee real-world recommendation probability. Results are interpreted separately by platform, question, and period.

- GEO Inside access: https://geoinside.ai/

## Service modules
- GEO Inside General: question design, repeated AI-answer measurement, brand/competitor/source diagnosis, prioritized improvements, and follow-up reporting.
- China GEO and visitor acquisition: a separately scoped partner service for Chinese-language questions, local AI-search diagnosis, content improvement, and selected visitor touchpoints. Target platforms and operating scope are confirmed after consultation.
- Law-firm and legal-office GEO: questions by practice, region, and consultation situation; comparison with official firm, lawyer, credential, and contact information; improvement of FAQ, case commentary, procedures, and consultation journeys. Legal content and advertising language require attorney review.
- Digital advertising and analytics.
- Content, social, exhibition, event, and esports operations.

Pricing for GEO, China GEO, and legal GEO is provided after consultation. No public fixed price is listed.

## Important limitations
- AI answers vary by question, time, region, account, and environment.
- ITING Communications does not guarantee a specific rank, mention rate, citation, inquiry volume, or revenue.
- China platforms are not represented as native GEO Inside measurement integrations.
- Public reference company names do not imply a specific scope, result, testimonial, or endorsement.
